parameters.question: Compare the regression evaluation metrics, aligning equivalent header labels and allowing column reordering. Require LOOCV metrics to have relative absolute error at most 5% against the reference. For the 80-20 train-test split, require positive R2 and internally consistent MSE, RMSE, and MAE, including RMSE approximately equal to sqrt(MSE) and MAE no greater than RMSE; do not require agreement with reference split values.
